cleanIntro: The Scorpion EVO 3 S1 strips with no tools at all: stock unfolded, slide locked back on the cocking handle, one push-through disassembly pin, and the whole trigger unit drops out backwards and downwards. It is a blowback with a polymer receiver, so what you are cleaning is mostly carbon on a bolt face and inside a plastic shell rather than a locking system. Everything below is read off the English section of CZ's SCORPION EVO 3 S manual, PDF pages 2 to 15.

steps.title: Confirm it is the S1 and not one of its two siblings
steps.action: Check your firearm against CZ's variants table. The book covers CZ SCORPION EVO 3 S1, the S1 CARBINE and the S2 MICRO, and the muzzle accessory is what distinguishes them: the S1 carries a compensator, the S1 CARBINE a barrel shroud, the S2 MICRO a flash hider.
steps.prose: All three are single-action-only in this civilian book and all three have sights and a threaded barrel, so the muzzle end is the reliable tell. It matters at cleaning time because the compensator on an S1 is a fouling trap in its own right and the CARBINE's shroud covers barrel you would otherwise be wiping. Read the table row, not the gun on the next bench.
steps.quote: The CZ SCORPION EVO 3 S series firearms enable firing single shots (Single Action) and they are made in several calibers with various barrel lengths.
steps.cite: CZ SCORPION EVO 3 S — INSTRUCTION MANUAL / MANUAL DE INSTRUCCIONES / NÁVOD NA POUŽITÍ / BEDIENUNGSANLEITUNG / MODE D'EMPLOI — UNKNOWN — not printed in the document — Description and Terminology, p.5

steps.title: Magazine out, then the chamber checked through a locked-back slide
steps.action: Point in a safe direction. Grasp the pistol grip in one hand and the magazine in the other, press the magazine catch with your thumb and pull the magazine down and out. Pull the cocking handle to the rear and confirm the chamber is empty; pushing the cocking handle upwards will fix the slide in the rear position so it stays open while you look.
steps.prose: The Scorpion's magazine is transparent polymer, so you can read the round count through the body before you even press the catch — do that, then still look in the chamber. The cocking handle latching up into its notch is the feature that makes this a genuine two-person check: one person holds it open, the other looks. Release the slide and pull the trigger as CZ's dry-fire step only once the chamber has been seen empty.
steps.quote: Pull the cocking handle into the rear position and make sure that the chamber is empty. By pushing the cocking handle upwards it is possible to fix the slide in the rear position while another person can check whether the chamber is empty.
steps.cite: CZ SCORPION EVO 3 S — INSTRUCTION MANUAL / MANUAL DE INSTRUCCIONES / NÁVOD NA POUŽITÍ / BEDIENUNGSANLEITUNG / MODE D'EMPLOI — UNKNOWN — not printed in the document — Operating Instructions — Unloading the gun, p.8
steps.warn: The cocking handle can be mounted on either the left or the right side of the hand guard, so where yours is is a setup decision on your own gun, not a fixed fact about the model.

steps.title: The stock is meant to be stiff — and an AR tube has a torque figure
steps.action: Do not treat a tight shoulder stock as a fault. CZ sets the removal deliberately stiff to take up joint clearance. If a non-folding AR type stock is being fitted instead, the tube position is fixed by two locking screws and the tube nut is tightened to 45 N ± 10 %.
steps.prose: This is the one place on a Scorpion where a number matters and it is easy to miss because it is buried at the end of an adjustment section. A tube nut left loose lets the stock rock under recoil; overtightened, it distorts a polymer receiver that has no business carrying that load. CZ also gives the friction cure for the folding stock rather than a looseness cure: smear the receiver surfaces with a preserving agent — graphite grease is their example — before reattaching, and use only agents intended for plastics.
steps.caution: Removal of the shoulder stock is set to be more difficult in order to take up the clearance in the joint to give the user better shooting comfort. That resistance is designed in; do not lever the joint to overcome it.
steps.quote: When installing a non-folding shoulder stock of the AR type, it is necessary to fix the tube position by two locking screws and then tighten the tube nut to 45 N ± 10 %.
steps.cite: CZ SCORPION EVO 3 S — INSTRUCTION MANUAL / MANUAL DE INSTRUCCIONES / NÁVOD NA POUŽITÍ / BEDIENUNGSANLEITUNG / MODE D'EMPLOI — UNKNOWN — not printed in the document — Operating Instructions — Removing the shoulder stock, closing note, p.9

steps.title: Unfold the stock and set the lever to fire — both before anything comes apart
steps.action: Unfold the shoulder stock from its folded position beside the receiver, then set the fire mode lever onto the fire mode position. CZ makes both of these numbered steps of the strip, ahead of any part being removed.
steps.prose: The stock has to be unfolded because folded it lies along the right side of the receiver directly over the area the trigger unit comes out of. The fire mode lever has to be at fire because on the "0" position the trigger mechanism is locked and the trigger unit cannot be worked out of the receiver. Neither is optional and neither is obvious from looking at the gun, which is why they are numbered rather than assumed.
steps.quote: 3. Unfold the shoulder stock. 4. Set the fire mode lever onto the fire mode.
steps.cite: CZ SCORPION EVO 3 S — INSTRUCTION MANUAL / MANUAL DE INSTRUCCIONES / NÁVOD NA POUŽITÍ / BEDIENUNGSANLEITUNG / MODE D'EMPLOI — UNKNOWN — not printed in the document — Maintenance Instructions — Stripping for Cleaning, steps 3 and 4, p.10

steps.title: Slide to the rear and locked there on the cocking handle
steps.action: Move the slide to the rear with the cocking handle and retain it by pushing the handle upwards into its notch. The slide is now safely locked in the rear position.
steps.prose: This is the same latch you used for the chamber check, doing structural work now: with the slide held back the recoil spring is compressed away from the trigger unit and the unit can drop without the slide chasing it. If the handle will not stay up, it has not gone fully into the notch — bring the slide a few more millimetres rearward and try again rather than forcing the handle. Keep a hand near the handle for the rest of this step; a slide that releases unexpectedly runs forward hard.
steps.quote: 5. Move the slide to the rear position with the aid of the cocking handle and retain it by pushing the handle upwards (Fig. 10). The slide is now safely locked in the rear position.
steps.cite: CZ SCORPION EVO 3 S — INSTRUCTION MANUAL / MANUAL DE INSTRUCCIONES / NÁVOD NA POUŽITÍ / BEDIENUNGSANLEITUNG / MODE D'EMPLOI — UNKNOWN — not printed in the document — Maintenance Instructions — Stripping for Cleaning, step 5, p.10

steps.title: Push the disassembly pin through, then take the trigger unit out backwards and down
steps.action: Grip the pistol grip tightly in one hand. With the thumb of the other hand push on the front part of the trigger unit and press the outer part of the disassembly pin, then extract the pin from the other side to its outermost position. Grasp the trigger unit case at the magazine housing and remove it by pulling it backward and downward.
steps.prose: The pin is a push-through captive and it comes out to a stop rather than out of the gun — do not keep pulling once it stops or you will be looking for it under the bench. The thumb pressure on the front of the trigger unit is what unloads the pin so it will move; without it the pin binds and people reach for a punch, which the Scorpion does not need for anything. The unit leaves on a curve, back then down, because its front lug is hooked into the receiver.
steps.aside: CZ lists as a characteristic feature of this firearm that the disassembly for cleaning and routine maintenance is very simple and can be achieved without any tools. If you have reached for a punch, something upstream is wrong.
steps.quote: Push onto the front part of the trigger unit with the thumb of the other hand and press the outer part of the disassembly pin (Fig. 11).
steps.cite: CZ SCORPION EVO 3 S — INSTRUCTION MANUAL / MANUAL DE INSTRUCCIONES / NÁVOD NA POUŽITÍ / BEDIENUNGSANLEITUNG / MODE D'EMPLOI — UNKNOWN — not printed in the document — Maintenance Instructions — Stripping for Cleaning, step 6, p.10

steps.title: Slide and recoil spring out through the bottom
steps.action: Move the slide slightly rearward with the thumb and pull it downwards. It is now possible to remove the slide together with the recoil spring.
steps.prose: With the trigger unit gone the underside of the receiver is open and the slide comes out downwards rather than off the back — a small rearward nudge unloads it from the latch, then it drops. Keep a hand under it; the recoil spring comes out with the slide and is still a compressed spring in an open hand. Watch that nothing else leaves with it: CZ's warning at this point is to make sure no part or spring is ejected, lost, or causes an injury while stripping.
steps.quote: 7. Move the slide slightly backwards with the thumb and pull it downwards. Now it is possible to remove the slide together with the recoil spring.
steps.cite: CZ SCORPION EVO 3 S — INSTRUCTION MANUAL / MANUAL DE INSTRUCCIONES / NÁVOD NA POUŽITÍ / BEDIENUNGSANLEITUNG / MODE D'EMPLOI — UNKNOWN — not printed in the document — Maintenance Instructions — Stripping for Cleaning, step 7, p.10

steps.title: Field strip complete
steps.action: Receiver with barrel, trigger unit, slide with recoil spring, and the magazine set aside — four groups, no tools used. That is the whole field strip CZ publishes for the SCORPION EVO 3 S1; the barrel, the hand guard, the cocking handle and the trigger unit's internals all stay assembled.
steps.prose: Those groups reach everything the cleaning section asks for: the barrel from the chamber end, the bolt face and extractor on the slide, the inside of the polymer receiver where blowback carbon collects, and the lubricating points marked on the inner cover page. CZ's line straight after step 7 is that nothing more is needed for routine maintenance, and the caution below it is unambiguous about going further. There is no deeper owner procedure published in this book.
steps.quote: No further disassembly is needed for routine maintenance. While stripping the gun make sure that no part or spring is ejected, lost or that it causes injuries.
steps.cite: CZ SCORPION EVO 3 S — INSTRUCTION MANUAL / MANUAL DE INSTRUCCIONES / NÁVOD NA POUŽITÍ / BEDIENUNGSANLEITUNG / MODE D'EMPLOI — UNKNOWN — not printed in the document — Maintenance Instructions — Stripping for Cleaning, closing note, p.10

deepAbsentReason: CZ's SCORPION EVO 3 S manual publishes no procedure past the seven-step field strip. Step 7 is followed immediately by "No further disassembly is needed for routine maintenance" and then by a CAUTION reading "Do not strip your firearm any further. If you assume that your firearm requires adjustment or repair, entrust this work to a competent gunsmith in a specialized workshop!" (p.10). Everything the book adds after that point is cleaning and adjustment of parts that stay on the gun — barrel and chamber, other parts, plastic magazines, lubricating points, the pistol grip position, the cocking handle side and the shoulder stock — not a second level of disassembly. Unlike CZ's CZ 75, Shadow and 600 books, this one gives the owner no firing pin, bolt or magazine strip at all, so there is nothing further to walk.

cleaning.name: BARREL & CHAMBER
tasks: Clean patch on the rod through barrel and chamber, changing patches, until the last one comes out clean — enough on its own if the S1 has fired only a few rounds
For a heavily fouled barrel, apply gun cleaning solution with a brush, let it act about 10 minutes, then scrub the barrel out thoroughly
Rod and brush enter from the CHAMBER end and the brush is pulled all the way through before reversing; changing direction inside the barrel sticks the brush
Clean inside the S1's compensator as a separate job from the bore — the ports carbon up faster than the rifling does
Dry barrel and chamber with a clean patch and confirm every trace of powder residue has gone

cleaning.name: SLIDE, BOLT FACE & RECEIVER
tasks: Dry cloth, old toothbrush, copper bristle brush or wooden scraper on the bolt face, the extractor and its cut, and the whole slide body — a blowback lays carbon on all of it
Clean the inside of the polymer receiver and the slide's guide surfaces; grit there is what makes a Scorpion feel gritty rather than any part being worn
Never use the agent designed for barrel cleaning on these parts — it stays in the joints and causes corrosion later
Check no cloth particles or brush bristles have lodged in any part of the firearm

cleaning.name: PLASTIC MAGAZINES
tasks: After extreme dusty or muddy use, or after long storage, wash the plastic parts of the magazine assembly in detergent
Dry it slightly and then leave it in the open air to finish drying
Do not preserve the magazine parts before reassembly and do not oil an assembled magazine — CZ states neither is necessary
Read the round count through the transparent body afterwards to confirm the follower is moving freely

cleaning.name: PRESERVING
tasks: With barrel, chamber and all accessible parts clean and dry, wipe them with a cloth soaked in gun oil or apply it as a spray
Apply oil to the lubricating points shown on the inner page of the cover, then remove all excess
At very low temperatures remove the oil from all accessible parts or use a lubricant intended for those conditions
Thick preserving grease is for long-term storage in severe climates only, and comes off every part before the firearm is used again
If the folding stock is stiff to refit, smear the receiver surfaces with a preserving agent intended for plastics — graphite grease is CZ's example

reassembly: Slide with its recoil spring back up into the receiver from below, then let it forward onto the cocking handle latch.
Trigger unit in front lug first, swung up and forward into the receiver at the magazine housing, then pressed home until it sits flush.
Push the disassembly pin back through to its seated position; it should go with thumb pressure once the trigger unit is fully up.
Release the cocking handle from its notch and let the slide run forward, then cycle it once by hand.

If the shoulder stock was removed: press the stock retaining button, insert the stock base from above onto the rails at the rear of the receiver, and push it to its lowest position — an audible click is the retaining button locking in.
Pull a dry patch through the barrel before the firearm is fired.
fncheck: Magazine out and chamber confirmed empty. With the fire mode lever on "0" the trigger must not move at all; on "I" it should break cleanly and reset. The cocking handle should latch the slide open when pushed up and release it cleanly when pushed down, and the slide should run its full travel without the disassembly pin creeping out. Check the trigger unit is seated flush at the magazine housing with no gap at the front lug, that the magazine seats and locks with a click, and that the shoulder stock's catch locates in its slot so the stock is secured against unwanted folding.
